reason: Provides a dsh plugin and standalone CLI proxy that inject a crypto.randomUUID polyfill and make a local web UI accessible from phones over a LAN.

summaries.zh: 通过注入 crypto.randomUUID 兼容补丁并提供局域网代理，让手机可以访问本地 dsh 网页界面。
summaries.en: Provides a dsh plugin and optional CLI proxy that add a crypto.randomUUID polyfill and expose a local web interface to phones over a LAN.

capabilities: Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into a web UI
Binds the web server or proxy to a LAN-accessible address
Proxies HTTP and WebSocket traffic from a local web application
